<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<title>遮罩揭示</title>
<style>
      button, [role="button"], select, summary, input:not([type="checkbox"], [type="radio"]) { min-height: 2rem; }
      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
      body { margin: 0; }

      :root {
        --bg: #f6f6f5;
        --surface: #ffffff;
        --surface-2: #efefee;
        --ink: #171717;
        --ink-2: #3d3d3d;
        --ink-3: #595959;
        --line: #e3e3e0;
        --accent: #111111;
        --accent-strong: #000000;
        --accent-soft: #eeeeee;
        --stage: #111111;
        --stage-2: #2a2a2a;
        --code-bg: #141414;
        --code-ink: #e6e6e6;
        --chip-bg: #ffffff;
        --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05), 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
        color-scheme: light;
      }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
        :root {
          --bg: #101010;
          --surface: #1a1a1a;
          --surface-2: #222222;
          --ink: #f2f2f2;
          --ink-2: #d2d2d2;
          --ink-3: #a8a8a8;
          --line: #2e2e2e;
          --accent: #f0f0f0;
          --accent-strong: #ffffff;
          --accent-soft: #242424;
          --stage: #0a0a0a;
          --stage-2: #1a1a1a;
          --code-bg: #0a0a0a;
          --code-ink: #e6e6e6;
          --chip-bg: #1a1a1a;
          --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 12px 32px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
          color-scheme: dark;
        }
      }

      body {
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: "Archivo", -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        line-height: 1.55;
      }
      .mono { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; }
      .wrap { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; }

      /* ---------- Header ---------- */
      header { padding: 44px 0 8px; }
      .brand-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .brand {
        font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px); letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1;
      }
      .brand .dot { color: var(--accent); }
      .brand-cn { font-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }
      .tagline { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: clamp(17px, 2.4vw, 22px); font-weight: 600; max-width: 640px; }
      .tagline em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-strong); }
      .tagline-en { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .14em; font-weight: 600; }
      .series-line {
        margin-top: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;
        background: var(--accent-soft); border: 1px solid var(--line);
        padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
      }
      .series-line .rec { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); animation: blink 1.6s infinite; }
      @keyframes blink { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .25; } }

      /* ---------- Five parameters ---------- */
      .params-strip { margin: 30px 0 6px; }
      .params-strip h2 { font-size: 15px; margin: 0 0 4px; font-weight: 700; }
      .params-strip p { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; max-width: 720px; }
      .params-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
      .param-cell {
        background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 12px 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      }
      .param-cell .num { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-strong); font-weight: 700; }
      .param-cell .name { font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; margin: 2px 0; }
      .param-cell .desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 1.5; }
      @media (max-width: 860px) { .params-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } .param-cell:last-child { grid-column: span 2; } }
      @media (max-width: 420px) { .params-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

      /* ---------- Toolbar ---------- */
      .toolbar {
        position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; margin-top: 26px;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .toolbar-inner { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
      .chip {
        appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--ink-2);
        border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
        font-family: inherit; min-height: 36px; transition: background .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s;
      }
      .chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
      .chip.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }
      .toolbar .count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-3); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; }

      /* ---------- Cards ---------- */
      .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; padding: 26px 0 10px; }
      @media (max-width: 1020px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
      @media (max-width: 640px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

      .card {
        background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px;
        overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      }
      .card.hidden { display: none; }

      .stage {
        position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 2.9; background: transparent;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center;
      }
      .stage .replay {
        position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; z-index: 5;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); color: #222; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.10);
        border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        min-height: 32px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.1); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.1);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75), 0 6px 18px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .stage .replay { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #eee; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18); } }
      .stage .replay:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.82); }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .stage .replay:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); } }
      .stage .cat-tag {
        position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 10px; z-index: 5;
        font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em;
        color: #444; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);
        padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .stage .cat-tag { color: #ddd; background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.16); } }

      .card-body { padding: 18px 18px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; flex: 1; }
      .name-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .name-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
      .name-row .en { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent-strong); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; }
      .principle { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
      .principle strong { color: var(--ink); }

      .specs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px 14px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
      .spec { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
      .spec .k { color: var(--ink-3); white-space: nowrap; }
      .spec .v { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; word-break: break-all; }

      .uses { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
      .use { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; align-items: baseline; }
      .use .tag {
        flex: none; width: 52px; text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700;
        border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 0; margin-top: 1px;
      }
      .use .tag.video { background: #eeeeee; color: #333; }
      .use .tag.page { background: #e2e2e2; color: #222; }
      .use .tag.ui { background: #d6d6d6; color: #111; }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
        .use .tag.video { background: #2a2a2a; color: #ddd; }
        .use .tag.page { background: #333; color: #eee; }
        .use .tag.ui { background: #3d3d3d; color: #fff; }
      }
      .use .txt { color: var(--ink-2); }
      .use .txt strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

      .card-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 4px; }
      .btn {
        appearance: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px;
        border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; min-height: 38px; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s;
      }
      .btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--bg); flex: 1; }
      .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); }
      .btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); flex: 1; }
      .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
      .btn.copied { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }

      .code-panel { display: none; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); padding: 14px 18px 18px; background: var(--surface); }
      .code-panel.open { display: block; }
      .code-label { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin: 10px 0 6px; }
      .code-label:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
      .code-label span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--ink-3); }
      .copy-mini {
        appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2);
        font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 7px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; min-height: 30px;
      }
      .copy-mini:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
      .copy-mini.copied { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }
      .prompt-box {
        background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6;
      }
      pre.code {
        margin: 0; background: var(--code-bg); color: var(--code-ink); border-radius: 10px;
        padding: 12px 14px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65;
        overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre;
      }

      /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
      footer { padding: 34px 0 56px; }
      .flywheel {
        background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 22px;
        display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      }
      .flywheel .step .t { font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; }
      .flywheel .step .d { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 2px; }
      .flywheel .arrow { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 900; font-size: 20px; }
      @media (max-width: 720px) { .flywheel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .flywheel .arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); justify-self: center; } }
      .foot-note { margin-top: 18px; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 13px; text-align: center; }

      /* ============================================================
         Preview animations — each pattern's live demo
         ============================================================ */
      .pv { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; }

      /* 1 · Spring Pop */
      .pv-pop .pop-btn {
        background: rgba(17,17,17,.92); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px;
        padding: 12px 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 12px 28px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        animation: pop 2.6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) infinite;
      }
      @keyframes pop {
        0%, 12% { transform: scale(.55); opacity: 0; }
        26% { transform: scale(1.09); opacity: 1; }
        33% { transform: scale(.96); }
        40%, 82% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
        94%, 100% { transform: scale(.55); opacity: 0; }
      }

      /* 2 · Split Stagger */
      .pv-split .line { overflow: hidden; display: flex; }
      .pv-split .ch {
        display: inline-block; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: .02em;
        animation: rise 3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) infinite;
      }
      @keyframes rise {
        0%, 8% { transform: translateY(115%); opacity: 0; }
        30%, 78% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
        92%, 100% { transform: translateY(-115%); opacity: 0; }
      }

      /* 3 · Mask Reveal — real photo revealed by the mask */
      .pv-mask .mask-frame {
        width: 72%; height: 64%; border-radius: 12px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5), 0 14px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
        animation: maskwipe 3.2s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1) infinite;
      }
      .pv-mask .mask-img {
        width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; object-fit: cover;
        filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.06);
      }
      .pv-mask .mask-cap {
        position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: 8px; z-index: 2;
        color: #fff; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: .14em; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
      }
      @keyframes maskwipe {
        0%, 10% { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }
        38%, 78% { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); }
        96%, 100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 100%); }
      }

      /* 4 · Magnetic Hover */
      .pv-mag .mag-btn {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.62); color: #171717; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px;
        padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 999px; will-change: transform;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.10);
        transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), 0 12px 26px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
        backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .pv-mag .mag-btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); color: #f2f2f2; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.20); } }
      .pv-mag .hint { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); }

      /* 5 · Scroll Parallax */
      .pv-para { overflow: hidden; }
      .pv-para .layer { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; }
      .pv-para .sun {
        width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.65); top: 16%;
        margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        animation: paraA 4.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .pv-para .hill-back {
        bottom: -14%; height: 62%; background: rgba(90,90,90,.38); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 34% 34% 0 0;
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        animation: paraB 4.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .pv-para .hill-front {
        bottom: -22%; height: 58%; background: rgba(35,35,35,.55); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 40% 40% 0 0;
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        animation: paraC 4.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .pv-para .para-title { position: relative; z-index: 3; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 900; font-size: 21px; text-shadow: none; animation: paraT 4.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
      @keyframes paraA { from { transform: translateY(14px); } to { transform: translateY(-16px); } }
      @keyframes paraB { from { transform: translateY(10px); } to { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
      @keyframes paraC { from { transform: translateY(2px); } to { transform: translateY(16px); } }
      @keyframes paraT { from { transform: translateY(8px); } to { transform: translateY(-10px); } }

      /* 6 · Count Up */
      .pv-count .num { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
      .pv-count .cap { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 2px; letter-spacing: .2em; }

      /* 7 · Blur Fade */
      .pv-blur .blur-txt { font-size: 27px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); animation: blurin 3.4s ease infinite; text-align: center; padding: 0 16px; }
      @keyframes blurin {
        0%, 10% { filter: blur(14px); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
        38%, 80% { filter: blur(0); opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        95%, 100% { filter: blur(10px); opacity: 0; }
      }

      /* 8 · Stroke Draw */
      .pv-draw svg { width: 120px; height: 120px; }
      .pv-draw .heart-path {
        fill: none; stroke: #222; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;
        stroke-dasharray: 320; stroke-dashoffset: 320;
        animation: draw 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      @keyframes draw {
        0%, 8% { stroke-dashoffset: 320; }
        48%, 80% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
        96%, 100% { stroke-dashoffset: -320; }
      }

      /* 9 · Squash & Stretch — 3D heart (layered extrusion + sway) */
      .pv-squash { perspective: 720px; }
      .pv-squash .heart-bounce {
        width: 64px; height: 60px; position: relative;
        transform-style: preserve-3d;
        animation: squash 1.7s cubic-bezier(.36,0,.64,1) infinite;
        transform-origin: 50% 100%;
        will-change: transform;
      }
      .pv-squash .heart-3d {
        position: absolute; inset: 0;
        transform-style: preserve-3d;
        animation: heartSway 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
        will-change: transform;
      }
      .pv-squash .h-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .pv-squash .h-layer svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
      .pv-squash .h-front svg { animation: heartLight 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .pv-squash .hl-main, .pv-squash .hl-small { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: heartHL 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .pv-squash .shade-l { animation: heartShadeL 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .pv-squash .shade-r { animation: heartShadeR 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes heartSway {
        0%, 100% { transform: rotateY(-36deg) rotateX(7deg); }
        50% { transform: rotateY(36deg) rotateX(-5deg); }
      }
      @keyframes heartLight {
        0%, 100% { filter: brightness(.78) contrast(1.06); }
        25%, 75% { filter: brightness(1.16) contrast(1); }
        50% { filter: brightness(.78) contrast(1.06); }
      }
      @keyframes heartHL {
        0%, 100% { transform: translate(12px, 1px) rotate(-24deg); opacity: .3; }
        50% { transform: translate(-14px, -1px) rotate(-24deg); opacity: .95; }
      }
      @keyframes heartShadeL {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
        50% { opacity: .65; }
      }
      @keyframes heartShadeR {
        0%, 100% { opacity: .65; }
        50% { opacity: 0; }
      }
      .pv-squash .floor { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(50% + 28px); width: 96px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.22); transform-origin: 50% 50%; animation: squashShadow 1.7s cubic-bezier(.36,0,.64,1) infinite; }
      @keyframes squash {
        0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-56px) scale(1, 1); }
        42% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1, 1); }
        50% { transform: translateY(4px) scale(1.28, .68); }
        60% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.9, 1.12); }
        74% { transform: translateY(-40px) scale(1, 1); }
      }
      @keyframes squashShadow {
        0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(.55); opacity: .45; }
        42% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); opacity: .85; }
        50% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1.3); opacity: 1; }
        60% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(.88); opacity: .75; }
        74% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(.68); opacity: .55; }
      }

      /* 10 · Marquee — component centered in the stage, both axes */
      .pv-marquee { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; }
      .pv-marquee .track { display: flex; gap: 10px; width: max-content; animation: marquee 9s linear infinite; padding: 0 5px; }
      .pv-marquee .mq-chip {
        flex: none; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.10); color: #333; border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 7px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      }

      .pv-splitview{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;height:100%}

      .split-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}.split-tags span{font-size:11px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)} .split-bottom .split-tags span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.10)}
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){.split-bottom .split-tags span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}}
      .split-handle{flex:none;height:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;cursor:ns-resize;touch-action:none;user-select:none;color:#666;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;position:relative;z-index:3;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}

      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){.split-handle::before{background:#eee;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.14)}}
      .split-ratio{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;color:#111;min-width:52px;text-align:center}

      .dual-foot{padding:10px 14px 16px;color:var(--ink-3);font-size:11px;text-align:center}

<main></main>
<template id="preview">
<div class="stage" data-stage="mask">
<span class="cat-tag">入场 · ENTER</span>
<div class="pv pv-mask"><div class="mask-frame"><img class="mask-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="云雾层叠的山峦照片" /><span class="mask-cap">PHOTO · 山峦云雾</span></div></div>
<button class="replay" type="button">↻ 重播</button>

<script>
function startCount(scope) {
        var el = scope.querySelector("[data-count]");
        if (!el) return;
        var target = 12480, dur = 1700, t0 = null;
        function tick(t) {
          if (!el.isConnected) return;
          if (!t0) t0 = t;
          var p = Math.min((t - t0) / dur, 1);
          var eased = 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * p);
          el.textContent = Math.round(target * eased).toLocaleString("en-US");
          if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          else setTimeout(function () { if (el.isConnected) startCount(scope); }, 1400);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }


      // ---------- Magnetic preview ----------
      function bindMagnetic(scope) {
        var btn = scope.querySelector("[data-mag]");
        if (!btn) return;
        var stage = btn.closest(".stage");
        if (!stage) return;
        stage.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
          var r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
          var x = e.clientX - (r.left + r.width / 2);
          var y = e.clientY - (r.top + r.height / 2);
          btn.style.transform = "translate(" + x * 0.3 + "px," + y * 0.3 + "px)";
        });
        stage.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { btn.style.transform = "translate(0,0)"; });
      }


      // ---------- New patterns: shared bind (works after replay clone too) ----------
      function bindNewPreviews(root) {
        if (!root || !root.querySelector) return;
        // Knockout: scroll -> scale outline title, late stage hands off to the solid block veil
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-knock-scroll]").forEach(function (sc) {
          if (sc.dataset.bound) return; sc.dataset.bound = "1";
          var title = sc.querySelector("[data-knock-title]");
          var veil = sc.querySelector("[data-knock-veil]");
          function clamp01(v) { return Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), 1); }
          function upd() {
            var max = Math.max(sc.scrollHeight - sc.clientHeight, 1);
            var p = clamp01(sc.scrollTop / max);
            var s = 1 + p * 8;
            if (title) title.style.transform = "scale(" + s + ")";
            if (veil) {
              var v = clamp01((p - 0.55) / 0.45);
              veil.style.opacity = String(v);
              veil.style.transform = "scale(" + (0.97 + v * 0.03) + ")";
            }
          }
          sc.addEventListener("scroll", upd, { passive: true }); upd();
        });
        // Folder tabs
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-folder-stack]").forEach(function (stack) {
          var wrap = stack.closest(".pv-folder"); if (!wrap || wrap.dataset.bound) return; wrap.dataset.bound = "1";
          var tabs = wrap.querySelectorAll("[data-folder]");
          var pages = stack.querySelectorAll(".folder-page");
          function activate(idx) {
            tabs.forEach(function (t, i) { t.classList.toggle("active", i === idx); });
            // order: active first, others by circular distance
            var order = Array.from(pages).map(function (_, i) { return i; }).sort(function (a, b) {
              var da = a === idx ? 0 : 1 + Math.abs(a - idx), db = b === idx ? 0 : 1 + Math.abs(b - idx); return da - db;
            });
            pages.forEach(function (pg, i) {
              var rank = order.indexOf(i); // 0 = front
              pg.style.zIndex = String(10 - rank);
              pg.style.transform = "translateY(" + (rank * 9) + "px) scale(" + (1 - rank * 0.035) + ")";
              pg.style.filter = "brightness(" + (1 - rank * 0.16) + ")";
              pg.style.opacity = String(1 - rank * 0.08);
            });
          }
          tabs.forEach(function (t) { t.addEventListener("click", function () { activate(+t.dataset.folder); }); });
          activate(0);
        });
        // Bubbles
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-bubble-field]").forEach(function (field) {
          if (field.dataset.bound) return; field.dataset.bound = "1";
          var defs = [
            { label: "弹簧", sub: "Pop", x: 8, y: 10, s: 74 }, { label: "视差", sub: "Scroll", x: 42, y: 4, s: 58 },
            { label: "错峰", sub: "Stagger", x: 68, y: 12, s: 82 }, { label: "磁吸", sub: "Magnet", x: 22, y: 44, s: 62 },
            { label: "揭示", sub: "Mask", x: 52, y: 42, s: 70 }, { label: "翻牌", sub: "Flip", x: 76, y: 48, s: 54 },
            { label: "跑马灯", sub: "Loop", x: 36, y: 70, s: 56 }
          ];
          var bubbles = defs.map(function (d, i) {
            var b = document.createElement("button"); b.type = "button"; b.className = "bubble";
            b.style.left = d.x + "%"; b.style.top = d.y + "%"; b.style.width = d.s + "px"; b.style.height = d.s + "px"; b.style.zIndex = String(i + 1);
            b.style.fontSize = d.s > 68 ? "14px" : "12px";
            b.innerHTML = d.label + "<small>" + d.sub + "</small>";
            b.dataset.cx = d.x; b.dataset.cy = d.y; b.dataset.size = d.s;
            field.appendChild(b); return b;
          });
          function layout() {
            var W = field.clientWidth || 320, H = field.clientHeight || 210;
            var centers = bubbles.map(function (b) {
              var s = +b.dataset.size * (b.classList.contains("selected") ? 1.18 : 1);
              return { x: (+b.dataset.cx / 100) * W + s / 2, y: (+b.dataset.cy / 100) * H + s / 2, r: s / 2, el: b, s: s };
            });
            // simple collision resolve: push apart overlapping pairs (2 iterations)
            for (var it = 0; it < 3; it++) centers.forEach(function (a, i) { centers.forEach(function (c, j) {
              if (j <= i) return; var dx = c.x - a.x, dy = c.y - a.y; var dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; var min = a.r + c.r + 4;
              if (dist < min) { var push = (min - dist) / 2; var ux = dx / dist, uy = dy / dist; a.x -= ux * push; a.y -= uy * push; c.x += ux * push; c.y += uy * push; }
            }); });
            centers.forEach(function (c) {
              var baseX = (+c.el.dataset.cx / 100) * (field.clientWidth || 320), baseY = (+c.el.dataset.cy / 100) * (field.clientHeight || 210);
              var dx = c.x - (baseX + c.r), dy = c.y - (baseY + c.r);
              var sc = c.el.classList.contains("selected") ? 1.18 : 1;
              c.el.style.transform = "translate(" + dx + "px," + dy + "px) scale(" + sc + ")";
            });
          }
          bubbles.forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { b.classList.toggle("selected"); layout(); }); });
          requestAnimationFrame(layout); setTimeout(layout, 120);
        });
        // Inline image
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-inline-thumb]").forEach(function (th) {
          if (th.dataset.bound) return; th.dataset.bound = "1";
          function tog() { th.closest("[data-inline]").classList.toggle("expanded"); }
          th.addEventListener("click", tog);
          th.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); tog(); } });
        });
        // Expand grid (event delegation per grid)
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-expand-grid]").forEach(function (g) {
          if (g.dataset.bound) return; g.dataset.bound = "1";
          g.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            var card = e.target.closest("[data-exp]"); if (!card) return;
            var was = card.classList.contains("expanded");
            g.querySelectorAll("[data-exp]").forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove("expanded"); });
            if (!was) card.classList.add("expanded");
          });
        });
        // Dual speed
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-dual-scroll]").forEach(function (sc) {
          if (sc.dataset.bound) return; sc.dataset.bound = "1";
          var L = sc.querySelector("[data-dual-left]"), R = sc.querySelector("[data-dual-right]");
          function upd() {
            var max = Math.max(sc.scrollHeight - sc.clientHeight, 1); var p = Math.min(Math.max(sc.scrollTop / max, 0), 1);
            if (L) L.style.transform = "translateY(" + (-40 * p) + "px)";
            if (R) R.style.transform = "translateY(" + (40 - 80 * p) + "px)";
          }
          sc.addEventListener("scroll", upd, { passive: true }); upd();
        });
        // Split view drag
        root.querySelectorAll("[data-splitview]").forEach(function (sv) {
          if (sv.dataset.bound) return; sv.dataset.bound = "1";
          var top = sv.querySelector("[data-split-top]"), bot = sv.querySelector("[data-split-bottom]"),
              handle = sv.querySelector("[data-split-handle]"), ratioEl = sv.querySelector("[data-split-ratio]");
          var ratio = 0.5, dragging = false;
          function apply(r, animate) {
            ratio = Math.min(0.75, Math.max(0.25, r));
            [top, bot].forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle("no-anim", !animate); });
            top.style.flexBasis = (ratio * 100) + "%"; bot.style.flexBasis = ((1 - ratio) * 100) + "%";
            if (ratioEl) ratioEl.textContent = Math.round(ratio * 10) + " : " + Math.round((1 - ratio) * 10);
          }
          function fromEvent(e) { var rect = sv.getBoundingClientRect(); var y = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY); return (y - rect.top - 11) / Math.max(rect.height - 22, 1); }
          handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) { dragging = true; handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); apply(fromEvent(e), false); e.preventDefault(); });
          handle.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) { if (dragging) apply(fromEvent(e), false); });
          function end() { if (!dragging) return; dragging = false; var snaps = [0.3, 0.5, 0.7]; var near = snaps.reduce(function (a, b) { return Math.abs(b - ratio) < Math.abs(a - ratio) ? b : a; }); apply(near, true); }
          handle.addEventListener("pointerup", end); handle.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
          apply(0.5, false);
        });
      }

const darkModes = [...document.styleSheets[0].cssRules]
  .filter(rule => rule.media?.mediaText === '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.source !== parent || event.data?.type !== 'motion:theme') return;
  const theme = event.data.theme;
  if (theme !== 'light' && theme !== 'dark') return;
  for (const rule of darkModes) rule.media.mediaText = theme === 'dark' ? 'all' : 'not all';
});
if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode') === 'card') document.body.dataset.card = '';
const main = document.querySelector('main');
const template = document.querySelector('#preview');
function renderPreview() {
  main.replaceChildren(template.content.cloneNode(true));
  startCount(main);
  bindMagnetic(main);
  bindNewPreviews(main);
}
main.addEventListener('click', event => {
  if (event.target.closest('.replay')) renderPreview();
});
renderPreview();
</script>
</body>
</html>

files.content: { "id": "mask", "cat": "enter", "catLabel": "入场 · ENTER", "name": "遮罩揭示", "en": "MASK REVEAL", "principle": "内容不动，用 clip-path 把“画布”一刀切开——揭示感比淡入更利落、更高级。", "specs": [ [ "时长", "800ms" ], [ "曲线", "cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)" ], [ "延迟", "100ms" ], [ "触发", "出现 / 转场" ] ], "uses": { "video": "场景转场——上一画面被切走，下一画面被切出来，无缝衔接", "page": "图片画廊入场——照片逐张揭示，像翻一本画册", "ui": "卡片图 hover——悬停时遮罩滑开露出第二张图或信息层" }, "prompt": "给这张照片加遮罩揭示入场：照片放在固定尺寸的容器里，clip-path 从 inset(0 100% 0 0) 动画到 inset(0 0 0 0)，800ms，cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.18,1)，照片本身保持不动、不要缩放。", "code": ".reveal { overflow: hidden; }\n.reveal img {\n width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;\n animation: wipe .8s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1) both;\n}\n@keyframes wipe {\n from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }\n to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); }\n}" }
